question: The TV-D1 test flight validated which system for the Gaganyaan mission?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CES**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The TV-D1 (Test Vehicle Demonstration 1) test flight validated the **Crew Escape System (CES)** for the Gaganyaan mission, which is India's first crewed spaceflight mission.
 
• The **Crew Escape System (CES)** is designed to ensure the safety of astronauts in the event of an emergency during the launch phase. It can rapidly propel the crew module away from the launch vehicle.
 
• The successful validation of the CES during the TV-D1 mission is a critical milestone for the Gaganyaan program, as it demonstrates India's capability to safeguard crew members under adverse conditions.
 
• The test vehicle carried an unpressurized crew module, simulating the actual module's mass and dimensions, to test the escape system's performance in real-time scenarios.
 
• The **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** conducted the TV-D1 test flight to achieve a significant step forward in its ambitious human spaceflight program.
